note.text: Guest privilege decision: the user account running Codex inside the MicroVM must have unrestricted passwordless sudo access to the guest. This is intentional and must not be weakened with guest-side privilege prompts. The security boundary remains the MicroVM, so guest root must still have no access to host privileges, host namespaces, arbitrary devices, privileged host sockets, host credentials, or any filesystem path beyond explicitly configured shares.
